title: VANA Group 3 Canonical Observation Contract — V2.2
description: GROUP 3 CANONICAL OBSERVATION CONTRACT V2.2 - FREEZE-READY, PENDING LIVE GROUP 1 ACCEPTANCE. Specified by Arya Barge; implemented by Hemanth Reddy. All four open contract questions and the coordinate-shape question were RULED by the contract owner on 2026-08-20. Her freeze condition is explicit: the schema can proceed to final freeze subject to the final live Group 1 acceptance/regression evidence. It is therefore NOT yet FROZEN - see _freeze_status.

contract_version.description: REQUIRED per Arya's field register, section 5 'Contract Metadata' — identifies the contract version used. Distinct from schema_version, which she marks as retained for compatibility only.

schema_version.description: OPTIONAL. Arya: 'Can be retained for compatibility if required.' contract_version is the canonical field in V2.2.

observation_id.description: Composite observation identity: Survey + Zone + Flight + Sensor + Observation sequence. CONFIRMED in Arya's settled-decisions table. Suraj Surve ruled 2026-08-17 'keep it as per Group 1'; the 2026-08-19 task lists replacing it with the flat form as out of scope. Group 1 preserves the caller-supplied identity verbatim. Identity is the WHOLE tuple including coordinates and timestamp — the OBS### fragment repeats every flight and is never unique alone.

source_identity.description: NEW in V2.2. Identity of the producing source — the Group 3 producer that emitted this observation, as distinct from device_id, which identifies the physical capturing device. Required so a reviewer starting at the canonical record can answer 'from which Group 3 producer?' without reconstruction.

survey_id.description: Survey identifier. CONFIRMED. Group 1's documented request body carries this as an explicit field, and Kavy is building v0.5 zone/flight queryability on these arriving explicitly rather than being parsed out of observation_id.

zone_id.description: Survey zone, Z1-Z8. CONFIRMED. This is the field that answers 'all observations in Z03 across flights' — the quarterly repeat-survey query. It must be explicit, not parsed.

observation_seq.description: Observation sequence within the flight. CONFIRMED. NOT globally unique on its own.

mission_id.description: Mission identity. REQUIRED per Arya's field register.

parent_reference.description: OPTIONAL. Links to a parent observation or mission package, where one exists. Null where the observation has no parent.

observation_timestamp.description: REQUIRED. Timestamp associated with the observation — the capture time. ISO-8601 UTC with an explicit timezone. If the clock cannot be trusted the observation carries data_state UNCERTAIN; a time is never invented. NOTE FOR GROUP 1: their live API currently accepts this on the wire as 'timestamp'. The wire name must be reconciled at Group 1 validator alignment. That is now a GROUP 1 item owned by Raj, not a contract-owner question - Arya ruled the contract on 2026-08-20 and it is freeze-ready. Consumers MUST enable format checking or impossible dates such as 2026-02-30T10:00:00Z validate cleanly. ISO-8601 UTC with an explicit UTC designator. Arya's Observation Metadata Contract section 6 (FROZEN): 'All capture timestamps shall use ISO-8601 UTC. Fractional seconds are permitted.' Both 'Z' and '+00:00' are accepted; a non-zero offset such as '+05:30' is NOT UTC and is rejected. Verified 2026-08-20: no non-zero offset appears anywhere in Group 3 or Group 1 evidence.

source_timestamp.description: OPTIONAL. Timestamp as originally supplied by the source, where it differs from observation_timestamp. Null where the source supplies none. ISO-8601 UTC with an explicit UTC designator. Arya's Observation Metadata Contract section 6 (FROZEN): 'All capture timestamps shall use ISO-8601 UTC. Fractional seconds are permitted.' Both 'Z' and '+00:00' are accepted; a non-zero offset such as '+05:30' is NOT UTC and is rejected. Verified 2026-08-20: no non-zero offset appears anywhere in Group 3 or Group 1 evidence.

ingestion_timestamp.description: RUNTIME-OWNED. Generated by canonical ingestion, not by the producer. Group 3 emits null and MUST NOT invent a value — the same rule that applies to trace_id. Arya classifies this as RUNTIME rather than YES/OPTIONAL for exactly that reason. ENFORCED 2026-08-20: constrained to null because it is runtime-owned. A producer populating it asserts a canonicalisation event it did not perform.

data_state.description: RULED by Arya Barge (contract owner), 2026-08-20. Two distinct REQUIRED axes: data_state represents the lifecycle/data state, quality_state represents the QA/quality verdict. They must NOT be merged or treated as aliases. Outright contradictions are rejected by validate_semantic_v22.py. NOTE: the contract owner retained the identical vocabulary for both axes; that is implemented as ruled and the enums are not differentiated. Vocabulary: RAW/CAPTURED/VALIDATED/REJECTED/UNCERTAIN/INGESTED.

synthetic_state.description: REQUIRED. THE CANONICAL ORIGIN FIELD in V2.2, replacing the V2.1 boolean. Arya: the boolean 'cannot represent all five required states', therefore 'synthetic_state is the canonical field'. PHYSICAL — produced by an actual physical device during an actual physical capture. CONTROLLED — produced during a controlled integration/test condition. SYNTHETIC — intentionally generated as synthetic test data. SIMULATED — produced by a simulator or simulation environment. UNKNOWN — the origin cannot be reliably established from available evidence. As of 2026-08-20 no Group 3 observation may be PHYSICAL: no Group 3 sensor has produced a recorded reading and 0 of 8 quadruped actuators are mounted.

is_synthetic.description: OPTIONAL, BACKWARD COMPATIBILITY ONLY. Arya's rule: 'If is_synthetic is retained for backward compatibility, it must not replace synthetic_state.' Mapping: PHYSICAL→false, CONTROLLED→true, SYNTHETIC→true, SIMULATED→true, UNKNOWN→null. HER WARNING, CARRIED VERBATIM: 'The compatibility mapping must not be interpreted as physical validation.' A false value means only that synthetic_state is PHYSICAL; it is not evidence that any device was tested, calibrated or verified. This field exists because Group 1's live API reads is_synthetic per observation — and because sending it at package level rather than per observation is what stored a synthetic record as false in their live canonical database on 2026-08-19.

calibration_state.description: RULED by Arya Barge (contract owner), 2026-08-20. Vocabulary is CALIBRATED, UNCALIBRATED, NOT_VERIFIED. UNCALIBRATED is used because it matches the live Group 1 v0.4 CHECK constraint character for character. NOT_CALIBRATED, from Observation Metadata Contract section 10, is NOT used in V2.2. Current Group 3 observations remain NOT_VERIFIED - no device holds a calibration record. CALIBRATED additionally requires hardware_verified true, enforced by validate_semantic_v22.py.

quality_state.description: RULED by Arya Barge (contract owner), 2026-08-20. The QA/quality verdict - a distinct REQUIRED axis from data_state, which carries the lifecycle state. The two must not be merged or treated as aliases. REQUIRED. Observation quality state — the field QA verdict. Maps to Group 1 v0.4's observation.quality_status, confirmed by Kavy via Raj on 2026-08-19. STATE OWNERSHIP (Manya Shukla, 2026-08-17): RAW set by the field/device capture layer at creation; CAPTURED set by the field acquisition process once observation and capture metadata are recorded; VALIDATED set by the validation/QA layer after all mandatory checks pass; REJECTED set when a mandatory rule fails; UNCERTAIN set when the observation is structurally usable but its quality is unresolved; INGESTED set by the downstream canonicalization layer. This is a QA verdict, NOT a pipeline position — never write PACKAGED, TRANSMITTED or CANONICAL here. ⚠ See data_state for the open overlap question.

location.description: RULED by Arya Barge (contract owner), 2026-08-20. NESTED IS RULED: use the nested location structure (location.latitude, location.longitude, location.altitude_m, etc.), because it preserves the GNSS and position-accuracy fields already represented and persisted in the Group 1 evidence. This closes the flat-vs-nested conflict between the Closure Plan and the JSON specification. Coordinates are WGS84/EPSG:4326; a coordinate is never invented - no fix means latitude and longitude null with quality_state UNCERTAIN.

latitude.description: Decimal degrees, WGS84 / EPSG:4326. Null ONLY when no GNSS fix was obtained, and then quality_state MUST be UNCERTAIN. A coordinate is never invented or defaulted.

longitude.description: Decimal degrees, WGS84 / EPSG:4326. Same rule as latitude.

altitude_m.description: Altitude above ground level in METRES. VERIFIED PERSISTED by Group 1 — live GET 2026-08-19 returned this field populated in geo_location. Without altitude a nadir RGB frame has no ground sample distance, so any extent derived from it is unscaled. Null only where the platform reports none; never estimated.

gnss_status.description: GNSS state at capture. VERIFIED PERSISTED by Group 1 in field_observation_meta — live GET 2026-08-19. Exists only in the nested specification. NOT_VERIFIED where the platform does not report it.

position_accuracy_m.description: Position accuracy in metres, ONLY if the platform actually reports it. VERIFIED PERSISTED by Group 1 in field_observation_meta — live GET 2026-08-19. Exists only in the nested specification. The Closure Plan is explicit: 'If accuracy is unavailable, GPS accuracy = NOT VERIFIED. Do not invent an accuracy value.' Null is that state here.

waypoint_id.description: OPTIONAL. Flight waypoint at which the observation was captured. Required in practice for the quarterly repeat-flight method — without it, two surveys of the same zone cannot be compared point-for-point. Null where the platform does not report waypoints.

device_id.description: REQUIRED. The producing physical device. Distinct from source_identity, which identifies the software producer. Group 4's file-based capability registry holds a placeholder entry for Group 3 at maturity V1, status DOCUMENTED — confirmed by Shivam 2026-08-20. Registration records that a capability is declared; it does not make a device tested or verified.

observation_type.description: REQUIRED. What was observed. Group 1 v0.4 uses this column for WHAT was measured (e.g. CARBON_STOCK, BIOMASS); capture_method carries HOW it was captured. Group 1's live ingestion confirmed this split on 2026-08-19 — Group 3's 'aerial' landed in capture_method and the parameter became observation_type.

capture_method.description: OPTIONAL. HOW the observation was captured. Maps to Group 1 v0.4's observation.capture_method, which Kavy added specifically to resolve the observation_type naming collision. Confirmed mapped by Group 1, 2026-08-19.

measurement.description: REQUIRED. The observation payload. Accepts three forms so that both the V1.2 wire shape Group 1 currently validates and the V2.1/V2.2 object form remain expressible during validator alignment: a number for a numeric measurement, a string for a descriptive one, or an object carrying artifact/value/parameter. ⚠ The single canonical form must be settled at Group 1 validator alignment. That is now a GROUP 1 item owned by Raj, not a contract-owner question - Arya ruled the contract on 2026-08-20. STRUCTURE RESTORED 2026-08-20: the V2.2 rewrite declared this as a bare union type and lost the object's inner properties, which V2.1 had. An object measurement could carry any keys, and a numeric value inside the object bypassed the unit rule entirely.

unit.description: OPTIONAL. Unit for a numeric measurement. Null for image or descriptive observations. 'IMAGE' is permitted where the Closure Plan vocabulary is used, though it denotes an artifact kind rather than a unit of measure.

raw_artifact.description: REQUIRED. Reference to the preserved original evidence. The raw file itself is NOT transmitted to the canonical store — the record holds the reference. Raw data survives; derived values travel alongside originals, never replacing them.

raw_artifact_integrity.description: REQUIRED. Arya's metadata contract section 11 states the raw artifact carries REQUIRED fields 'path' and 'artifact_type'. The path is the top-level raw_artifact; artifact_type lives here, so this object and its artifact_type are mandatory. TIGHTENED 2026-08-20: previously optional and nullable, so an observation could reference an artifact of wholly unknown kind. checksum_sha256 and hash_algorithm remain nullable - a device that cannot hash must say so rather than carry a placeholder.

checksum_sha256.description: Computed at capture where the edge device supports it. Null where it does not — NEVER a placeholder value.

integrity_reference.description: OPTIONAL. Links the observation to its integrity/hash evidence, where that evidence lives outside raw_artifact_integrity. Null where the inline integrity block is sufficient.

provenance_reference.description: RULED by Arya Barge (contract owner), 2026-08-20. REQUIRED and non-empty. The reviewer-facing pointer to provenance evidence, distinct from the inline provenance object.

provenance.description: REQUIRED. Device / mission / capture provenance. Answers the Day-1 acceptance question: which device produced this, when, where, and which original evidence supports it. REQUIRED SET WIDENED 2026-08-20: Arya's metadata contract section 13 specifies required provenance as device_id, mission_id, captured_at AND raw_artifact (operator and qa_record optional). The V2.2 rewrite required only the first two, so provenance could omit both the capture time and the link to the original evidence - which is most of what provenance is for.

device_id.description: MUST equal the top-level device_id. Cross-field agreement is NOT expressible in JSON Schema and is enforced by contract/validate_semantic_v22.py, which exists and runs. An earlier draft cited that validator before it was written; that claim was false and is corrected.

captured_at.description: REQUIRED, and MUST equal observation_timestamp. May be null ONLY where the clock could not be trusted (metadata contract section 6: 'the system shall not invent a timestamp'); in that case data_state MUST be UNCERTAIN - enforced by validate_semantic_v22.py. ISO-8601 UTC with an explicit UTC designator. Arya's Observation Metadata Contract section 6 (FROZEN): 'All capture timestamps shall use ISO-8601 UTC. Fractional seconds are permitted.' Both 'Z' and '+00:00' are accepted; a non-zero offset such as '+05:30' is NOT UTC and is rejected. Verified 2026-08-20: no non-zero offset appears anywhere in Group 3 or Group 1 evidence.

raw_artifact.description: REQUIRED. MUST equal the top-level raw_artifact. Provenance links Device -> Operator -> Mission -> Raw Artifact; a null here breaks the last link.

tidal_state.description: OPTIONAL — environmental context. Recorded SEPARATELY from the measurement and never inferred from an image. CANONICAL STATUS: DEFERRED TO GROUP 1 v0.5 — Kavy placed it on the v0.5 list 2026-08-17 and Raj reconfirmed the deferral 2026-08-19. Group 3 may emit it; Group 1 will NOT persist it. Object and string forms are both accepted during validator alignment because Group 1's live V1.2 validator types this as string|null. STRUCTURE RESTORED 2026-08-20: the V2.2 rewrite lost the object's inner definition. An object with no 'state' key validated cleanly, which defeats the purpose of recording tidal state at all.

trace_id.description: OPTIONAL, RUNTIME-INJECTED. Group 3 emits null and MUST NOT invent a value. Format 'VANA-<12 lowercase hex>' per Group 1's live API, which returns a trace on every response. Karan Barda ruled 2026-08-14 that execution_id, trace_id, tenant_id and lineage_hash are runtime-owned. KNOWN ISSUE: Group 1's trace is per-REQUEST, not per-observation — four calls on one observation returned four different traces on 2026-08-19 — so it cannot correlate an observation over time. Group 4's runtime separately uses a 16-hex 'trace-vana-' form; the two schemes are unreconciled.

idempotency_key.description: OPTIONAL. Derived from observation_id. Sent as the Idempotency-Key header to Group 1's POST /observations, whose documented contract is 201 ACCEPTED, 200 IDEMPOTENT_REPLAY, 409 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT, 409 DUPLICATE.

hardware_verified.description: OPTIONAL. Whether the producing device has completed PRESENT → TESTED → CALIBRATED → VERIFIED. FALSE for every Group 3 device as of 2026-08-20. Suraj ruled that day: 'The available Oak-D Pro and T-Motor 4-in-1 are only classified as PRESENT, not VERIFIED.'

accuracy.description: RULED by Arya Barge (contract owner), 2026-08-20. Metadata Contract section 18 confirmed: accuracy remains MANDATORY. It must be either a verified numeric value or the literal NOT_VERIFIED; no estimated value may be invented. Null is not permitted - an absent value does not record THAT the check was made. A numeric value additionally requires hardware_verified true. GROUP 1 MAPPING: v0.4 stores the pair accuracy NUMERIC + accuracy_status TEXT. NOT_VERIFIED maps to accuracy null + accuracy_status NOT_VERIFIED; a number maps to accuracy <n> + accuracy_status SPECIFIED. Both confirmed on live records - no distinction is lost.

processing_status.description: RULED by Arya Barge (contract owner), 2026-08-20. Metadata Contract section 18 confirmed: processing_status remains MANDATORY. Stage in the processing chain - raw and derived must stay distinguishable once derived values travel alongside originals. Maps to Group 1 v0.4 field_observation_meta.processing_status. No controlled vocabulary is specified in the contract; a non-empty string is enforced.

allOf.$comment: Location rule: a missing coordinate cannot claim VALIDATED.
Arya's compatibility mapping: synthetic_state PHYSICAL is the ONLY state permitting is_synthetic false.
A PHYSICAL observation requires hardware evidence. As of 2026-08-20 no Group 3 device qualifies.

REGRESSION FIX 2026-08-20: V1.2 enforced 'a numeric measurement requires a unit' and V2.2 lost it when unit became OPTIONAL per Arya's field register. OPTIONAL is right for image and descriptive observations; it is wrong for numeric ones - a canopy height of 4.7 with no unit is meaningless. The rule is conditional on measurement being a number, which preserves both.
MAPPING FIX 2026-08-20: Arya's table maps PHYSICAL->false. Only the is_synthetic=false direction was enforced. This closes the reverse: PHYSICAL must not carry is_synthetic true.
MAPPING FIX 2026-08-20: the non-physical half of Arya's table. CONTROLLED, SYNTHETIC and SIMULATED all map to is_synthetic true, so none may carry false.
STRUCTURE FIX: object-form measurement must carry artifact or value, and nothing else.
UNIT FIX: the numeric-requires-unit rule must apply to the OBJECT form too. A value of 4.7 inside measurement.value is exactly as meaningless without a unit as a bare 4.7.
A descriptive measurement must actually describe something - empty string rejected.
STRUCTURE FIX: object-form tidal_state must carry a state from the Closure Plan vocabulary.
String-form tidal_state must still use the agreed vocabulary.

_authorship.contract_owner: Arya Barge — Canonical Observation Contract & Provenance Owner
_authorship.specification: GROUP 3 - CANONICAL OBSERVATION CONTRACT V2.2, 2026-08-20, plus the contract owner's rulings of 2026-08-20 which closed all four open questions and the coordinate shape.
_authorship.note: Group 3's earlier V2.0/V2.1 were built and versioned by Hemanth without the contract owner ruling on them. That is corrected here: V2.2 is Arya's specification, implemented rather than authored by the integration role.

_physical_boundary: No Group 3 observation may carry synthetic_state PHYSICAL as of 2026-08-20. No Group 3 sensor has produced a recorded reading; 0 of 8 quadruped actuators are mounted; available hardware is PRESENT only, per Suraj's ruling. The schema enforces this structurally: PHYSICAL requires hardware_verified true, and is_synthetic false requires synthetic_state PHYSICAL.

_contract_owner_rulings.ruled_by: Arya Barge - Canonical Observation Contract & Provenance Owner

rulings.ruling: V2.2 canonical vocabulary is CALIBRATED, UNCALIBRATED, NOT_VERIFIED. UNCALIBRATED is used because it matches the live Group 1 v0.4 constraint. NOT_CALIBRATED is not used in V2.2. Current Group 3 observations remain NOT_VERIFIED.
rulings.supersedes: Observation Metadata Contract section 10, which specified NOT_CALIBRATED and a space-separated NOT VERIFIED.

rulings.ruling: Two distinct REQUIRED axes. data_state represents lifecycle/data state; quality_state represents the QA/quality verdict. Both retained. Outright contradictions rejected. They must not be merged or treated as aliases.
rulings.note: The owner retained the identical vocabulary for both axes. That is her ruling and is implemented as given; the enums are NOT differentiated.

rulings.ruling: Required and non-empty. It is the reviewer-facing pointer to provenance evidence and is distinct from the inline provenance object.
Confirmed. accuracy and processing_status remain mandatory. Accuracy must be either a verified numeric value or NOT_VERIFIED; no estimated value may be invented.

Use the nested location structure (location.latitude, location.longitude, location.altitude_m, etc.). This preserves the GNSS and position-accuracy fields already represented/persisted in the Group 1 evidence.
rulings.note: Closes the flat-vs-nested conflict between the Closure Plan and the JSON specification. Suraj had delegated this to Dhruv; the contract owner has now ruled.

closed_by_the_rulings: Calibration vocabulary - RULED UNCALIBRATED/NOT_VERIFIED, which also closes Group 3 mismatch M-1 against Group 1 v0.4's live CHECK constraint.
data_state vs quality_state - RULED two axes.
accuracy and processing_status mandatory - RULED confirmed.
still_owned_by_group_1: Validator alignment to the V2.2 shape: wire field name timestamp vs observation_timestamp, and a single canonical measurement form. Raj is holding this change.
Repair of live record TC-Z03-F02-LIDAR-OBS001, stored is_synthetic false for a synthetic observation, and removal of the diagnostic control TC-Z03-F02-LIDAR-OBS009.

TC-Z03-F02-ACCEPTANCE-OBS1787138092 carries gnss_status FIX, position_accuracy_m 0.25, accuracy_status SPECIFIED and calibration_status CALIBRATED. Those were probe values written before the no-invention rules were enforced; no Group 3 device holds a GNSS fix, a position accuracy figure or a calibration record. The record is correctly flagged is_synthetic true, but the hardware values in it are not real and Group 3 would not emit them today.
_freeze_status.accuracy_mapping_to_group_1: RESOLVED, verified against the live record 2026-08-19. Group 1 v0.4 stores the pair field_observation_meta.accuracy NUMERIC and field_observation_meta.accuracy_status TEXT. Group 3's accuracy maps onto that pair with no loss: the literal NOT_VERIFIED becomes accuracy null plus accuracy_status NOT_VERIFIED, and a verified number becomes accuracy <n> plus accuracy_status SPECIFIED. Both spellings are confirmed present on live records - NOT_VERIFIED on TC-Z03-F02-LIDAR-OBS001 and SPECIFIED on TC-Z03-F02-ACCEPTANCE-OBS1787138092. Group 1 implemented Group 3's proposed accuracy_status column, so mismatch M-2 is CLOSED. An earlier note in this file called M-2 a blocking obstacle; that was wrong and is corrected here.

group_1_column_alignment_verified.calibration_status: CLOSED - v0.4 CHECK is CALIBRATED/UNCALIBRATED/NOT_VERIFIED; the contract owner's ruling adopts exactly this. NOT_VERIFIED confirmed persisted live. Mismatch M-1 closed.
group_1_column_alignment_verified.processing_status: CLOSED - field_observation_meta.processing_status confirmed persisted live (values chm_derived and raw observed).
group_1_column_alignment_verified.artifact_type: CLOSED IN PRACTICE - Group 3's lowercase point_cloud was stored verbatim on the live record. There is no CHECK constraint on the column, so the vocabularies should still be agreed in writing to prevent divergence. Mismatch M-3 downgraded from open to advisory.
group_1_column_alignment_verified.altitude_m / gnss_status / position_accu: CLOSED - all three confirmed persisted with real values on TC-Z03-F02-ACCEPTANCE-OBS1787138092 (45.2, FIX, 0.25). This is the evidence behind the contract owner's nested-location ruling.
